ucs.title: [LLM] MuddyWater RMM-tool deployment via spearphishing link (Atera/ScreenConnect/SimpleHelp)
ucs.description: Hunts MuddyWater's signature 2022-2024 tradecraft: phishing emails (often from compromised partner mailboxes) carrying links to legitimate Remote Monitoring & Management installers (Atera Agent, ScreenConnect/ConnectWise, Syncro, SimpleHelp, RemoteUtilities) used as first-stage implants instead of custom malware. Correlates the inbound link with an RMM agent installer spawned from a browser/Outlook/archive process in a user-writable path.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("AteraAgent.exe","atera_agent.exe","ScreenConnect.ClientSetup.exe","ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe","ScreenConnect.WindowsClient.exe","Syncro.exe","SyncroSetup.exe","rutserv.exe","rfusclient.exe","SimpleHelpCustomer.exe","RemoteUtilities.exe") OR Processes.process IN ("*atera*","*screenconnect*","*simplehelp*","*remoteutilities*","*syncro*")) AND (Processes.parent_process_name IN ("chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","outlook.exe","winrar.exe","7zFM.exe","explorer.exe")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.process_path 
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` 
| where match(process_path, "(?i)\\\\(Downloads|Temp|AppData)\\\\") 
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` 
| `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
let RmmInstallers = dynamic(["AteraAgent.exe","atera_agent.exe","ScreenConnect.ClientSetup.exe","ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe","ScreenConnect.WindowsClient.exe","Syncro.exe","SyncroSetup.exe","rutserv.exe","rfusclient.exe","SimpleHelpCustomer.exe","RemoteUtilities.exe"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(14d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","outlook.exe","winrar.exe","7zFM.exe","explorer.exe")
| where FileName in~ (RmmInstallers)
   or ProcessCommandLine has_any ("atera","screenconnect","simplehelp","remoteutilities","syncro")
| where FolderPath has_any (@"\Downloads\", @"\Temp\", @"\AppData\")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let RmmInstallers = dynamic(["ateraagent.exe","atera_agent.exe","screenconnect.clientsetup.exe","screenconnect.clientservice.exe","screenconnect.windowsclient.exe","syncro.exe","syncrosetup.exe","rutserv.exe","rfusclient.exe","simplehelpcustomer.exe","remoteutilities.exe"]);
ImProcessCreate
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| where ParentProcessName has_any ("chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","outlook.exe","winrar.exe","7zfm.exe","explorer.exe")
| where ActingProcessName has_any (RmmInstallers)
   or ActingProcessCommandLine has_any ("atera","screenconnect","simplehelp","remoteutilities","syncro")
| where ActingProcessCommandLine has_any (@"\Downloads\", @"\Temp\", @"\AppData\")
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, ActingProcessName, ActingProcessCommandLine, ParentProcessName, SHA256
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: MuddyWater RMM Agent Installer Spawned From Browser or Outlook
id: 7c2f1b3a-9d4e-4f81-bf2a-1c6e0a5d3e92
status: experimental
description: Detects MuddyWater-style first-stage RMM installer (Atera, ScreenConnect, Syncro, SimpleHelp, RemoteUtilities) launched from a browser, Outlook or archive tool out of a user-writable directory.
references:
  - https://www.microsoft.com/security/blog/2023/04/mercury-mango-sandstorm
author: SOC Detection Engineering
tags:
  - attack.command_and_control
  - attack.t1219
  - attack.t1204.001
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\chrome.exe'
      - '\msedge.exe'
      - '\firefox.exe'
      - '\outlook.exe'
      - '\winrar.exe'
      - '\7zFM.exe'
      - '\explorer.exe'
  selection_rmm:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\AteraAgent.exe'
      - '\ScreenConnect.ClientSetup.exe'
      - '\ScreenConnect.WindowsClient.exe'
      - '\Syncro.exe'
      - '\SyncroSetup.exe'
      - '\rutserv.exe'
      - '\SimpleHelpCustomer.exe'
      - '\RemoteUtilities.exe'
  selection_path:
    Image|contains:
      - '\Downloads\'
      - '\Temp\'
      - '\AppData\'
  condition: selection_parent and selection_rmm and selection_path
falsepositives:
  - Sanctioned IT support deploying RMM agents to user endpoints
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\chrome.exe OR *\Chrome.exe OR *\msedge.exe OR *\MsEdge.exe OR *\firefox.exe OR *\Firefox.exe OR *\outlook.exe OR *\OUTLOOK.EXE OR *\winrar.exe OR *\WinRAR.exe OR *\explorer.exe OR *\Explorer.exe) @Image:(*\AteraAgent.exe OR *\ateraagent.exe OR *\ScreenConnect.ClientSetup.exe OR *\screenconnect.clientsetup.exe OR *\Syncro.exe OR *\syncro.exe OR *\rutserv.exe OR *\SimpleHelpCustomer.exe OR *\RemoteUtilities.exe) (@Image:(*\Downloads\* OR *\downloads\*) OR @Image:(*\Temp\* OR *\temp\*) OR @Image:(*\AppData\* OR *\appdata\*))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/(chrome|msedge|firefox|outlook|winrar|7zfm|explorer)\.exe/i
| ImageFileName=/(AteraAgent|atera_agent|ScreenConnect\.Client(Setup|Service|)|ScreenConnect\.WindowsClient|Syncro(Setup)?|rutserv|rfusclient|SimpleHelpCustomer|RemoteUtilities)\.exe/i
| regex("(?i)\\\\(Downloads|Temp|AppData)\\\\", field=ImageFileName)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, ParentBaseFileName], function=count())
ucs.rationale: MuddyWater (Mango Sandstorm/MERCURY, Static Kitten, Seedworm, TA450) is the most prolific abuser of legitimate RMM software as a primary implant among Iranian state actors — Microsoft and Group-IB documented their pivot away from custom POWERSTATS toward Atera/ScreenConnect/Syncro/SimpleHelp delivered via phishing links throughout 2022-2024. ucs.title: [LLM] MuddyWater obfuscated PowerShell backdoor from document/script host (POWERSTATS / MuddyC2Go chain)
ucs.description: Hunts MuddyWater's long-running execution chain where a maldoc or script host (Word/Excel/mshta/wscript/cscript) spawns hidden, base64/encoded PowerShell acting as a downloader or backdoor (POWERSTATS, Powermud, MuddyC2Go staging). Decodes the -EncodedCommand inline to expose the staged payload.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")) AND (Processes.parent_process_name IN ("winword.exe","excel.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","cmd.exe","explorer.exe")) AND (Processes.process="*-enc*" OR Processes.process="*EncodedCommand*" OR Processes.process="*FromBase64String*" OR Processes.process="*DownloadString*" OR Processes.process="*Invoke-Expression*" OR Processes.process="*IEX*" OR Processes.process="*hidden*" OR Processes.process="*-nop*" OR Processes.process="*Net.WebClient*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process 
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` 
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` 
| `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("winword.exe","excel.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","cmd.exe","explorer.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("-enc","-EncodedCommand","FromBase64String","DownloadString","IEX","Invoke-Expression","-w hidden","-windowstyle hidden","-nop","-noprofile","Net.WebClient","bitsadmin")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| extend B64 = extract(@"(?i)-e(?:nc(?:odedcommand)?)?\s+([A-Za-z0-9+/=]{20,})", 1, ProcessCommandLine)
| extend Decoded = base64_decode_tostring(B64)
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          FileName, ProcessCommandLine, B64, Decoded, SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
ImProcessCreate
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where ActingProcessName has_any ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")
| where ParentProcessName has_any ("winword.exe","excel.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","cmd.exe","explorer.exe")
| where ActingProcessCommandLine has_any ("-enc","-EncodedCommand","FromBase64String","DownloadString","IEX","Invoke-Expression","-w hidden","-windowstyle hidden","-nop","-noprofile","Net.WebClient","bitsadmin")
| where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
| extend B64 = extract(@"(?i)-e(?:nc(?:odedcommand)?)?\s+([A-Za-z0-9+/=]{20,})", 1, ActingProcessCommandLine)
| extend Decoded = base64_decode_tostring(B64)
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, ParentProcessName, ActingProcessName, ActingProcessCommandLine, B64, Decoded
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: MuddyWater Obfuscated PowerShell Spawned From Office or Script Host
id: 3a9d7e21-5b6c-4af0-9e1d-8c2f4b7a0d63
status: experimental
description: Detects hidden/encoded PowerShell launched by Word, Excel, mshta or a script host, matching MuddyWater POWERSTATS / MuddyC2Go staging chains.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0069/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
tags:
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.t1027
  - attack.t1218.005
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\winword.exe'
      - '\excel.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\explorer.exe'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
  selection_obfusc:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '-enc'
      - 'EncodedCommand'
      - 'FromBase64String'
      - 'DownloadString'
      - 'Invoke-Expression'
      - 'IEX'
      - 'hidden'
      - 'Net.WebClient'
  condition: selection_parent and selection_child and selection_obfusc
falsepositives:
  - Legacy login scripts or admin automation launched from cmd/wscript
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\winword.exe OR *\WINWORD.EXE OR *\excel.exe OR *\EXCEL.EXE OR *\mshta.exe OR *\MSHTA.EXE OR *\wscript.exe OR *\WScript.exe OR *\cscript.exe OR *\CScript.exe OR *\explorer.exe OR *\Explorer.exe) @Image:(*\powershell.exe OR *\PowerShell.exe OR *\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\pwsh.exe) @CommandLine:(*-enc* OR *EncodedCommand* OR *FromBase64String* OR *DownloadString* OR *Invoke-Expression* OR *IEX* OR *hidden* OR *Net.WebClient* OR *-nop*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/(winword|excel|mshta|wscript|cscript|explorer|cmd)\.exe/i
| ImageFileName=/(powershell|pwsh)\.exe/i
| regex("(?i)(-enc|EncodedCommand|FromBase64String|DownloadString|Invoke-Expression|IEX|hidden|-nop|Net\.WebClient|bitsadmin)", field=CommandLine)
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName], function=count())
ucs.rationale: Encoded/hidden PowerShell descending from an Office app or mshta/wscript is the defining MuddyWater (TEMP.Zagros, Seedworm) execution primitive across POWERSTATS, Powermud and the more recent MuddyC2Go/PhonyC2 frameworks documented by Symantec, ClearSky and Deep Instinct — the actor consistently chains maldoc/script-host delivery (T1204.002/T1218.005) into obfuscated PowerShell (T1059.001/T1027) r
